policy: Known visual/body conflicts are never silently resolved. Explicit owner decisions below are canonical for the affected visual question.

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: PDF says two arms/two legs; owner hand-drawn concept shows four arms/two legs.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: four arms/two legs; hand-drawn concept controls

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: PDF says small horns sometimes; concept art shows stronger horn/tail grammar and pointed ears.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: tails canonical; horns optional/broadly variable; pointed ears noncanonical; optional wings added; otherwise mostly human facial/body grammar

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: Kobold-reference sheet includes hornlike structures while strongest current concept does not.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: no horns; swept-back structures are ears; IMG_20240811_115259 is closest; black face marking is real feathers

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: PDF does not explicitly state tail and uses general rodent framing.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: mouse-related; tail canonical; fur control up to three colors plus pattern/texture

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: PDF baseline does not fully specify the tail/fin grammar shown in owner concept.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: hand-drawn concept is baseline; tail/fin size and shape vary; Forms remain separate

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: PDF gives both 5–6.5 ft and under 5 to just over 6 ft.
PDF gives both 4–5 ft and 3–4 ft.
archive PDF describes gorilloid origin; newer owner MHT describes ursine uplift and owner confirms bear physiology.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: anthropomorphic bears; newer MHT and owner decision supersede gorilloid visual origin

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: subspecies are Grendelkin/Surtrborn/Daityr but example NPC prose uses Skyborn/Stoneborn/Flameborn.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: only first three are canonical lineages; legacy labels are naming errors

resolved_conflicts.source_conflict: written prose describes prominent lower canines while visual references vary with/without visible tusks.
resolved_conflicts.resolution: lower canines/tusks may be nonvisible; most Orcs do not show prominent tusks
